# MCP tools: Contacts

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 10 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `list_contacts`

Use this to resolve a person the user mentions (name, alias, email or phone) to a Contact id.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `contacts:read`.

Returns: `ContactPageResult` with `contacts` (array of ContactSummaryRecord), `include_archived` (boolean), `next_cursor` (string or null), `q` (string or null), `tag_match` (string), `tags` (array of string).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 100 |
| `q` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |
| `tag_match` | string | no | default `"any"`; one of `any`, `all` |
| `tags` | array of string | no | up to 5 items; may be null |

## `get_contact_context`

Use this after the Contact id is known, for example from list_contacts or create_contact, to retrieve that owned active Contact, bounded current Project/Task context and up to 10 newest linked Journal entries (id, date and title only; read a Journal entry for its content), or to answer who a Contact is.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `contacts:read`, `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `ContactContextResult` with `contact` (ContactRecord), `journal_entries` (JournalEntryContextRecord), `projects` (ProjectContextPageRecord), `tasks` (TaskContextPageRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contact_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `include_completed` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `project_cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `project_limit` | integer | no | default `10`; 1 to 25 |
| `task_cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `task_limit` | integer | no | default `10`; 1 to 25 |

## `list_task_contacts`

Use this after a Task UUID is known to list the owned Contacts linked to that Task as a bounded, paginated page of Contact summaries.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `contacts:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `TaskContactPageRecord` with `items` (array of ContactSummaryRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `20`; 1 to 50 |

## `create_contact`

Use this only when the user has asked to create one Contact.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `contacts:read`, `contacts:write`.

Returns: `ContactResult` with `contact` (ContactRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | string | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `address` | string | no | up to 500 characters; may be null |
| `aliases` | array of string | no | may be null |
| `context_note` | string | no | may be null |
| `email` | string | no | may be null |
| `organization` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |
| `phone` | string | no | may be null |
| `relationship` | string | no | up to 80 characters; may be null |
| `role` | string | no | up to 120 characters; may be null |
| `tags` | array of string | no | up to 10 items; may be null |

## `update_contact`

Use this for explicit edits to one known owned active Contact.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `contacts:read`, `contacts:write`.

Returns: `ContactResult` with `contact` (ContactRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` | object | yes | - |
| `changes.address` | string | no | up to 500 characters; may be null |
| `changes.context_note` | string | no | up to 10000 characters; may be null |
| `changes.display_name` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |
| `changes.email` | string | no | up to 320 characters; may be null |
| `changes.organization` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |
| `changes.phone` | string | no | up to 64 characters; may be null |
| `changes.relationship` | string | no | up to 80 characters; may be null |
| `changes.role` | string | no | up to 120 characters; may be null |
| `changes.tags` | array of string | no | up to 10 items; Complete tag set, e.g. 'important', 'waiting', 'family'; replaces the current set, [] clears it. |
| `contact_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `expected_version` | integer | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `project_id` | uuid | yes | - |
